claim: A pursuit whose rule the world refutes plans again inside itself, over what is still validated, without anything asking; one with nothing new is not planned again, and one whose world cannot be observed is never planned against an invented world.
hypothesis: If the drive asks, whenever a walk stops, whether a rule its route stood on lost its authority, then a refutation caused by acting makes the same pursuit plan again rather than strand its goal.

checks.label: no second pursuer of a goal exists on the live substrate
the registry still names the LIVE substrate
checks.detail: a later AutonomousCoordinator() would have displaced it

checks.label: the pursuit proved a route and walked it
the act ran and the world CONTRADICTED the rule
it PLANNED AGAIN, over what is still validated, without anything asking
and ended saying so, not claiming the goal
checks.detail: state space exhausted at 0 state(s); no sequence of the available actions achieves the goal

checks.label: the route that stopped was closed as NOT reached
the world is where the refusal left it — nothing was forced
a pursuit whose rules hold in an unchanged world is NOT planned again
a goal whose world cannot be observed is not planned at all
...and a stopped walk there is not planned again on a world nobody read
